## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) for the practice of the *Liánhuábù* 蓮華部 (Lotus-family) yoga, oriented toward Avalokiteśvara as the central deity. CANWWW alt-title: *Liánhuábù xīnsòng fǎmén* 蓮華部心誦法門. The text is one of the principal liturgical manuals of the *Liánhuábù* — one of the three (later five) "families" of the Tang Esoteric *Vajraśekhara* maṇḍala system.

**Abstract**

The Esoteric *kula*-system (Chinese *bù* 部, Sanskrit *kula* "family") organises the deities of the maṇḍala into three (later five) families, each headed by a Buddha and including subsidiary bodhisattvas, *vajra*-deities, and protector-figures. The **Lotus-family** (*Padma-kula* / 蓮華部) is the *prajñā* (wisdom) family, headed by **Amitābha** with **Avalokiteśvara** as its central *bodhisattva*. The present manual provides the ritual practice for the Lotus-family yoga, focused on Avalokiteśvara as the embodiment of *mahā-karuṇā* (great compassion). It belongs to a series of Avalokiteśvara-focused ritual manuals that Amoghavajra produced — including [KR6j0229](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0229), [KR6j0230](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0230), and [KR6j0231](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0231) — that together form the principal Tang-period ritual literature of the Avalokiteśvara cult within the Esoteric framework.
